puc_control_same_session.command: taskset -c 0 perf stat -e instructions:u ./build/lua-c/lua tools/microbench.lua global_arith
puc_control_same_session.note: PUC itself is bimodal across processes (9.60G / 10.51G, +9.5%) on the identical workload file in the identical session — the reference implementation has the same class of per-process data-dependent variation (its own string-hash seed randomization).

measured_structural_separation.observable: the _ENV table's Node chain AT THE MAIN POSITION of the hot global's name key ('g_count'): env_node_depth (0 = alone at main position; 1 = displaced behind a colliding key) and env_node_chain_len (nodes reachable from that main position)
measured_structural_separation.result: ALL 8 low-mode seeds have env_node_depth=0/chain_len=1; ALL 7 high-mode seeds have env_node_depth=1/chain_len>=2. Exact separation, zero exceptions, reproducible across repeated runs of the same seed.
measured_structural_separation.intern_chain_negative_result: The intern-table chain depth of 'g_count' itself is 0 in BOTH modes (measured) — the intern-chain hypothesis from the earlier artifact version is DISPROVEN as the separating mechanism and is not claimed.
measured_structural_separation.branch_corroboration: Low/high branch medians differ; the delta and per-iteration values are exactly mechanical_summary.delta_branches and mechanical_summary.delta_branches_per_iteration (recomputed by tools/validate_noise_lanes.py; the earlier hand-written branch-delta prose was arithmetically wrong and is corrected mechanically).

conclusion_bounded.proven: On the CANONICAL microbench workload (byte-identical file + args + setup), the VM hash seed deterministically selects one of two instruction modes (per-seed placement observables separate them 15/15; the mode medians and their instruction/branch deltas are exactly the fields of mechanical_summary, recomputed by tools/validate_noise_lanes.py).
conclusion_bounded.inferred_not_disassembled: The instruction-level attribution of the per-iteration instruction delta (mechanical_summary.delta_instructions_per_iteration) to the extra chain-node visit in the GETTABUP/SETTABUP table-get path is CONSISTENT with the measured per-iteration branch delta (mechanical_summary.delta_branches_per_iteration) — see mechanical_summary for the exact numbers; they are recomputed by tools/validate_noise_lanes.py, not restated by hand here.
conclusion_bounded.not_claimed: No claim about workloads other than global_arith; no claim that the intern-string table chain is the mechanism (disproven above); no wall-time causality (wall is dominated by scheduling; see seed 55 wall outlier).

gate_implication: Any cross-process wall/instruction comparison of global_arith samples one of two seed-controlled modes. The fail-safe gate prints the NOISE? diagnostic but preserves threshold verdicts. Baselines record multi-run medians: a median of N bimodal samples SELECTS the mode containing the middle order statistic — it does not merge modes; sessions sampling the other mode FAIL with a visible NOISE? (documented in baseline-approved.json baseline_identity).
